rows.note: This is the everyday all-purpose causative for saying that something gives A the right to do or have something.

example.english: This pass will entitle you to come and go freely.
example.traditional: 呢張通行證畀你有權自由出入㗎。
example.jyutping: ni1 zoeng1 tung1 haang4 zing3 bei2 nei5 jau5 kyun4 zi6 jau4 ceot1 jap6 gaa3

rows.note: Use this when the entitlement specifically grants A formal authority to carry out V.

example.english: The authorization letter will entitle security guards to inspect visitors' luggage.
example.traditional: 份授權書授權保安員檢查訪客嘅行李。
example.jyutping: fan2 sau6 kyun4 syu1 sau6 kyun4 bou2 on1 jyun4 gim2 caa4 fong2 haak3 ge3 hang4 lei5

rows.note: Use this for the ownership slice, when something makes A the rightful owner of B.

example.english: This will will entitle him to own this flat.
example.traditional: 呢份遺囑令佢擁有呢層樓。
example.jyutping: ne1 fan6 wai4 zuk1 ling6 keoi5 jung2 jau5 ne1 cang4 lau4
